name: switch
title: Switch
description: An animated switch for React and shadcn, which becomes a full settings row when given a label.

meta.details: A Base UI switch whose thumb springs across and, while pressed, stretches toward where it is going. With a label it becomes a settings row whose whole label toggles it.

docs: Import Switch from components/eased/switch/switch. Props: checked, defaultChecked, onCheckedChange, name, value, disabled, required, children (label), description. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import.
